xb:0x00072D90.by: Read from the code (Claude (AI), for RRutherrfordd), with the examiner's notes
xb:0x00072D90.why: Sets the script namespaces up: makes the "Namespace Pool" (0x28-byte records, at [0x0047B358]) and "Namespace Entry Pool" (0x1C-byte, [0x0047B360]) and the two 512-bucket tables ([0x0047B35C], [0x0047B364]), and fills the 36 engine callback keys at 0x0047B2C0 from their names (Initialize, Terminate, OnStateCreated ...).

xb:0x00072270.by: Read from the code (Claude (AI), for RRutherrfordd), with the examiner's notes
xb:0x00072270.why: Walks every namespace in the 512 buckets at [0x0047B35C] and every entry on its list (+0x18, next +0x10), releasing each entry's script code (+0x08) with 0x0006E0F0.

xb:0x00072FE0.name: Namespace::CreateLocalEntry
xb:0x00072FE0.by: Read from the code (Claude (AI), for RRutherrfordd), with the examiner's notes
xb:0x00072FE0.why: thiscall(namespace, key): returns the namespace's own entry for the key from its list (+0x18, next +0x10), or takes a new one from the entry pool ([0x0047B360], virtual 16), marks its type invalid (+0x1A |= 0x1F), links it at the list head and in bucket ((namespace key ^ key) >> 2) & 0x1FF of [0x0047B364]. The name follows the published Torque engine's Namespace::createLocalEntry (MIT licence), the engine the game's script system descends from; what the function does was read from the game.

xb:0x00072420.name: Namespace::Lookup
xb:0x00072420.by: Read from the code (Claude (AI), for RRutherrfordd), with the examiner's notes
xb:0x00072420.why: thiscall(namespace, key): looks in bucket ((namespace key ^ key) >> 2) & 0x1FF of [0x0047B364] for an entry of this namespace (+0x0C) with that key (+0x00, next +0x14), then tries the parent (+0x04) and so on up; returns the entry or 0. How a script's call finds its function. The name follows the published Torque engine's Namespace::lookup (MIT licence), the engine the game's script system descends from; what the function does was read from the game.
